observations.notes: Maintainer receipt records an ESPHome 2026.7.0 proxy, Home Assistant 2026.7.2, Android app coexistence, probe readings and bounded cook/proxy endurance. Bound to 3.0.0-rc only.

observations.exact_model: Performer Deluxe Smart 57 / Performer Premium Smart
observations.notes: The report says the built-in grill-temperature entity and external probes worked, and the model has two physical probe ports. It is not a controlled endurance or current-release test.

Community comment reports a 3.5-hour manual cook with the Android app open, restart recovery and stable IDs/nicknames. It also reports fuel changes and two cloud gaps; endurance is not marked passed. Bound to RC3 only.

Empty-grill manual trial on HA 2026.10.2, firmware 2.0.3_7398, app open and BLE proxy off: cooking/model/warnings corrected, stable IDs, real low/full agrees, all three cloud gaps self-recovered. Fuel flicker and 2-5.5 minute gaps remain; no controlled endurance pass or RC5 acceptance.

feedback.summary: Cooking appeared off during an active manual SmokeFire cook.
feedback.disposition: RC4 counts an active appliance in a known cooking mode without requiring app recipe/alert sessions. The RC4 empty-grill trial confirms manual cooking through shutdown; exact-RC5 physical regression is pending.

feedback.summary: SmokeFire appeared with a generic Hub model label.
feedback.disposition: RC4 uses observed model evidence or a recognized SmokeFire title. Its community trial confirms the SmokeFire label; RC5 remains pending hardware regression.

feedback.summary: Certificate loading could block Home Assistant setup.
feedback.disposition: HTTPS opener creation is deferred into the executor request path. The RC4 reporter confirms the blocking-SSL warning disappeared; RC5 physical regression is pending.

feedback.summary: A deprecated unscoped device lookup was reported.
feedback.disposition: Firmware updates use a config-entry-scoped lookup compatible with the HA baseline. The RC4 reporter confirms the deprecated-registry warning disappeared; RC5 physical regression is pending.

feedback.summary: SmokeFire fuel reports changed between full and unknown during the community run.
feedback.disposition: RC4 diagnostics report no unknown/invalid fuel codes. RC5 bridges brief reconnects with individually aged fuel samples for at most 60 seconds, expires stale samples and applies explicit device unknown/low/full immediately. Synthetic regressions pass only after the fix; exact-RC5 hardware results remain pending.

feedback.summary: SmokeFire cooking-time cloud gaps last multiple minutes despite automatic recovery.
feedback.disposition: RC4 recovered its three reported gaps automatically. Its aggregate recovery maximum includes overnight off time and recent events cover the off period. The active-gap cause remains unresolved; request during/after-gap JSON, time/state histories, live app readings and concurrent HA connectivity. RC5 does not claim to fix these gaps.

feedback.summary: Genesis issue 65 reports a response-framing failure after controller discovery.
feedback.disposition: SiLabs classification and setup are implemented, but no successful reporter pairing, physical approval, cloud association or live reading is recorded. Do not relax framing without sanitized controller evidence and a regression fixture.

feedback.summary: Issue 59 reports an EP-435-style thermometer with no visible approval prompt.
feedback.disposition: No successful pairing evidence or reviewed support report is recorded. The exact controller, firmware, approval result and last successful stage remain needed.

feedback.summary: Cloud status stayed connected while Home Assistant stopped receiving readings.
feedback.disposition: RC5 clears the current cloud status during transport failures and reconnects; the old device report is separate historical context. A fresh appliance report restores status. Synthetic entity/diagnostic regressions cover failure, persistent loss and recovery; hardware validation is pending.

feedback.summary: Runtime evidence is bound to the exact candidate fingerprint and must not be carried across candidates.
feedback.disposition: RC4 community observations remain bound to RC4. RC5 physical receipts are pending with no inherited verified hardware stages.
